intro: Magga is an orc resident living in the Valley of Trials within Durotar. Stationed near the Den, she serves as a welcoming face for newly arrived Horde adventurers beginning their journey in the valley.

sections.t: A Welcoming Face in the Valley of Trials
p: The Valley of Trials is the first taste of the world for young orcs and darkspear trolls. Positioned near the Den, Magga greets new arrivals to the valley. While she keeps a low profile among the valley's busy trainers and recruits, she helps bind the small camp together.
